reuse.gap: G872 measured/descriptive fit, not an ear verdict: canonical Coral coastal bed, 28 s, -24.9 LUFS integrated, LRA 4.9 LU, peak -6.7 dBFS; 59% energy at 500 Hz to 2 kHz and 21% at 2 to 6 kHz, under 1% below 150 Hz, spectral flatness 0.21 with no tonal peaks, envelope CV 0.66. Soft irregular lagoon water and coastal breeze fit the open harbour basins. Harbour clutter is carried by five local spots. No airship hum, rigging or tower flag; the failed airship-tower cue remains unshipped. Jake judges by ear on the listening page.
